title: W7 'Packed orders' reads a server-side awaiting_load list (packed, on no draft or confirmed load sheet), newest pack first by server time, with the pack time and a bounded 'Show older packs'
rootCause:
Three defects on one path. The set that loadSheets.create accepts is never exposed for reading.

1. Screen. frontend/warehouse-app/app/load/index.tsx:55-58 calls `api.api.warehouse.packs.list({ limit: 50 })` with no filter.
   - It never reads `nextCursor`.
   - The panel at :179-209 prints every row of that page with no pack time.
   - The file is unchanged since c5c6e03 (QA/evidence/batch1/regression/part-b-regression-status.md §2).

2. Server. backend/libs/core/src/modules/warehouse/packing.service.ts:163-209 (`PackingService.list`) has no 'waiting for a vehicle' predicate.
   - Its filters (:167-177) are only from/to on packed_at, picklistId, orderId and invoiced.
   - It orders by the client-generated id, `.orderBy(desc(packConfirmations.id))` at :182, and pages with `lt(packConfirmations.id, cursor)` at :176.
   - Contract: `PacksListInput` (backend/libs/contracts/src/warehouse.ts:625-634) has no such field. The header (:79-83) documents 'the other lists are ordered by id descending'.

3. Data.
   - Seeded packs carry demoId() sha1-shaped ids (backend/libs/database/src/seed-demo/ids.ts:55-80), which sort above every live UUIDv7 ('01a09…').
   - The saved response QA/evidence/batch1/regression/web-chain/api-14-warehouse-packs-list-limit50.json starts at ffea1a46… SO-0798 (packedAt 4 Sep) and has nextCursor efeb289f…. The fresh batch-2 template (dos_test_batch2_template) starts at the same ffea1a46… SO-0798.
   - In dos_qa, tarsun has 848 packs: 782 delivered, 53 partially delivered, 4 dispatched and 9 packed.

Why W7 needs create's own rule, not only 'no draft sheet'.
- `LoadSheetsService.create` (load-sheets.service.ts:165-189) accepts an order only when all three hold:
  - `fulfilmentOrders(...).state === 'packed'` (:165-171);
  - it has a pack_confirmations row (:172-184);
  - it is on no sheet with `status <> 'cancelled'` (`onALiveSheet`, :754-767). Draft AND confirmed sheets count.
- The order state is required; the sheet anti-join alone is wrong in both directions:
  - Too wide: delivery `TripsService.dispatchIfPacked` (trips.service.ts:844-858, called at :383) dispatches a packed order that was never on a sheet.
  - Too narrow for plain 'packed': `return_undelivered` (backend/libs/domain/src/state-machines/order.ts:48; orders/fulfilment.ts:60-68) puts an order back to `packed` while its confirmed sheet still lists it, and create refuses it.
- Examples of the second case:
  - Seeded, present in the fresh template: SO-0845 and SO-0850, on confirmed sheet d2853293 of settled TRIP-20260910-1.
  - dos_qa: SO-0857 (sheet 29067d2f) and SO-0904 (sheet 01a097a7).
  - Each has a dispatched → packed return_undelivered transition.

Boundary.
- Warehouse never selects from sales_orders (orders/fulfilment.ts:15-17; picklists.service.ts:103-105), so the state predicate has to come from the orders module.
- Orders is upstream of warehouse, and `OrdersService` is already injected in PackingService (:72).

Ground truth: read-only SQL for packed + pack row + on no non-cancelled sheet, ordered created_at desc, id desc.
- dos_qa:
  - tarsun: SO-0909 (13 Sep 03:27, INV/9014 cancelled), SO-0883 (01:27), SO-0892 (01:16), SO-0862 (11 Sep 11:30).
  - sai-distributors: SO-0437.
  - SO-0903/0905/0906 from the finding have since been delivered by the chain.
- dos_test_batch2_template, which every lane DB is copied from:
  - tarsun: SO-0862 only; sai-distributors: SO-0437.
  - Left out: SO-0845/SO-0850 (returned onto a confirmed sheet), SO-0869/0871/0875/0876/0878 (TRIP-NEXT draft sheet 374f2089) and SO-9001 (packed with no pack confirmation).

No second cause.
- W7 reads online through @dos/api-client; no sync handler, worker job or RLS policy is involved.
- Every packs.list caller role already reads pack_confirmations, load_sheets and sales_orders under RLS.

Same class as DOS-023, whose fix (bdd6055, picklists.service.ts:286-305) moved picklists to `created_at desc, id desc` with a keyset on the cursor row.

contractChange:

The from/to and invoiced filters cannot express it: a pack from yesterday not yet loaded must show, and a returned order on a confirmed sheet must not.

decisionsNeeded:
One sequencing call for the gate. It does not block implementation.
- After DOS-133, W7 reliably offers a packed order whose bill was cancelled before dispatch. dos_qa example: SO-0909 / INV/9014, the DOS-139 case. W7 still prints INV/9014 in a green chip.
- loadSheets.create already accepts it by API.
- The exposure is not new: today W7 lists ALL packs of any tenant with ≤ 50 packs, cancelled-bill packs included, so a newly onboarded distributor already reaches it. The DOS-139 regression note's 'W7 would not list the pack' holds only at the pilot tenant's seeded volume.
- Options:
  - (a) land DOS-139 (billing cancel moves the order out of `packed`) before or together with DOS-133;
  - (b) ship DOS-133 as designed and re-grade DOS-139 to P1 in batch 2;
  - (c) make awaiting_load also exclude packs whose invoice is cancelled. Not recommended: the list would differ from what create accepts, and that rule belongs to DOS-139.
- Recommendation: (b), with (a) if DOS-139's design is ready when this lane merges.
architectDesignFollowed:
amended. The one-line design is completed where the code proves it incomplete:
(1) `awaiting_load` = order state `packed` AND on no DRAFT or CONFIRMED sheet (`status <> 'cancelled'`), which is loadSheets.create's own acceptance rule (load-sheets.service.ts:165-189, :754-767). The design says only 'no live load sheet'. A return_undelivered order is `packed` while its confirmed sheet still lists it (template SO-0845/SO-0850; dos_qa SO-0857/SO-0904), and create refuses it with 409, so offering it would fail at Build.
(2) The 'not dispatched' half is an order-state predicate owned and exported by the orders module (`OrdersService.orderInState`), because warehouse never selects from sales_orders (fulfilment.ts:15-17). The sheet anti-join alone would list orders dispatched by trips.depart with no sheet (trips.service.ts:844-858).
(3) `created_at desc, id desc` applies to every packs.list call with the DOS-023 keyset cursor. An id cursor over a created_at order would skip or repeat rows.
(4) W7 also shows the pack time in IST and a bounded 'Show older packs' (50 → the contract cap of 200, which is also create's max orders per sheet), per the finding's Expected ('with paging or a date filter').
(5) Added `pack_confirmations_created_idx (tenant_id, created_at, id)`, so that ordering by created_at does not sort the tenant's whole pack history on every packs.list call (docs/20 rules 3 and 8). The design did not name an index.

risk:
Low to medium.
(1) Planner. With the new index, the awaiting_load query could in principle be planned as a backward walk of pack_confirmations_created_idx, probing each row. For a very large tenant with few waiting packs that is slow. At pilot volume it hash-joins from the packed orders (dos_qa EXPLAIN, 3.5 ms). Step 2 records the plan; revisit if it walks the index.
(2) Live-sheet anti-join. It scans the tenant's non-cancelled sheets per candidate, because no index serves jsonb containment. It is bounded by the packed-order count and is the same cost class as create's onALiveSheet. Confirmed sheets accumulate for ever, so a GIN index on load_sheets.order_ids is a later scale item, outside this finding.
(3) DOS-139 becomes routinely visible (see decisionsNeeded).
(4) Cursor semantics. The cursor is still a pack id, now resolved to that row's (created_at, id). No app pages packs.list today, and an unknown cursor returns an empty page, as in DOS-023.
(5) Cross-module predicate. Warehouse's query embeds a sales_orders EXISTS written and owned by the orders module. core has no precedent for a SQL predicate crossing a module boundary (no SQLWrapper use today). If the architect rejects the pattern, the fallback is a capped list of `packed` order ids from OrdersService filtered with inArray: a simpler boundary, but silently incomplete once returned-undelivered orders pile up past the cap.
(6) Side effect by design. M20 'Packed' (manager pack.tsx:346), W1's and W5's unbilled backlogs and the billing desk now show today's packs first instead of hash-id order. Nothing there depends on id order.
(7) Merge overlap:
- W7 index.tsx with DOS-131+137 (lands first, same lane);
- warehouse-app strings.ts with DOS-043 (same lane);
- migrations/_journal.json and snapshots with DOS-032+059 (take the next free index after 0043/0044, and regenerate rather than hand-renumber if another lane merged a migration first);
- READMEs with every contract-changing plan (regenerate after rebase).
